what: A WebGL 3D plate that pushes a single photo forward by its depth map on a 128×128 plate (field of view 19° · camera 2.65) — it slowly turns following the mouse up to .17 horizontally · .09 vertically rad (3% of the remaining distance per frame), sways as if breathing at .5 speed even when still, and on hover the upper-left light, matched to normals made from the depth gradient, turns on 8% per frame. Without a depth map it makes a plate bulging in the middle by blurring the cut-out alpha · brightness. Given a lens mask and a reflection video, it reflects the video only on the lens area — compressing plate UV to 2.35x · vertical .54 and raising it by −.67, then reading it bent by fisheye (3.45), lowering color to saturation .75 · brightness .6 at 1.3x strength, and adding a CRT texture of vertical RGB grid 6px and horizontal scanlines 5px. The video shifts UV −.03 · .02 by cursor position, and splits R · B by x .012 · y .006 with cursor speed (movement/60 accumulated, .94 decay per frame), following at .12. With lit, when the plate turns, the normals turn toward or away from the front light (−3.3 · −4.2 · 4) and the back light, changing the whole plate brightness
ease: At 60fps, follows by 0.03 per frame (exponential decay, frame-length corrected)

options.intensity: Mouse horizontal rotation (rad), default .17 — hero portrait .12
options.intensity-v: Mouse vertical rotation (rad), default .09 — hero portrait is .016
options.ease: Follow share per frame, default .03 — hero uses .025
options.disp: Amount pushed forward by depth, default .18 — hero is .165
options.breath: Breath speed, default .5 — hero is .75 · 0 means no breathing
options.overscan: Scale at which the panel covers the element, default 1.12
options.light: Whether the light turns on when hovered (on/off), default on
options.lit: Whether to change brightness with normal lighting as the panel rotates (on/off), default off — hero portrait is on (original ambient 3 · front 4 · back light 1.25)
options.light-pos: lit front light position x,y,z, default -3.3,-4.2,4
options.lens-hsb: Lens video hue rotation, saturation and brightness multipliers, default 0,.75,.6
options.lens-pan: Lens video UV shift by the cursor position x,y, default -.03,.02
options.split: Cursor velocity R·B split x,y (UV), default .012,.006
options.sheen-hsb: Bundled light hue, saturation and brightness multipliers, default 0,2.8,1

note: three (_vendor/three@0.174.0/build/three.cjs) is loaded first as window.THREE. The image and depth children are hidden (fx.css) and the canvas (data-fx-part="stage") covers that spot. Changing --fx-reveal (0 to 1) on the element style makes it melt up from the bottom into view — this is where the intro timeline passes the progress value. It is not drawn when off screen. Lens children (all hidden): data-fx-part="lens"(Lens mask — only the white area shows video, same ratio as the photo) · "reflection"(a video or a canvas that keeps redrawing — re-read every frame) · "sheen"(bundle light, overlay via alpha) · "logo"(marker, multiply by alpha). Turns on only when both lens and reflection exist. The cursor response joins via smoothstep once the intro progress (--fx-reveal) passes .85
